research_question: When all empirically supported DV capabilities are integrated, does the complete system improve the verified-success/cost/latency frontier versus strong simple baselines after every control, context, handoff, verification, coordination, and maintenance-relevant overhead is counted?
precondition: P5 integrates only capabilities individually supported by prior gates; unsupported components are excluded rather than retained for completeness.

systems.S0_STRONG_DIRECT: best practical strong single-agent/executor baseline with minimal verifier appropriate to the task
systems.S1_SIMPLE_CASCADE: best simple deterministic cascade surviving P1
systems.S2_THIN_DV: only minimal supported routing/state/verification rules; no unsupported advanced controller
systems.S3_SUPPORTED_FULL_DV: all and only capabilities supported by prior experiments
systems.S4_MAXIMAL_AGENTIC: maximal practical orchestration/composition baseline when available

frontier_rule: No system wins by a single scalar alone. Promotion requires a materially useful Pareto-frontier improvement or a predeclared constrained operating point that simpler baselines cannot match.
task_distribution_requirements: multiple repositories or materially different code surfaces where feasible
mix of localized and broader tasks
ablation_requirements: remove independent verifier where safe and scientifically meaningful
null_hypothesis: Best simple/fixed systems achieve an equivalent or better practical frontier after complete overhead accounting.
success_condition: At least one externally confirmed, operationally useful frontier region remains unavailable to simpler baselines and the gain survives complete-system accounting.
failure_conditions: strong direct dominates or is economically acceptable at the required success level
external providers/frameworks reproduce the same effect at lower maintenance cost
gain fails sealed holdout or distribution-shift check
complexity_rule: If an ablation shows a component has no positive marginal utility within uncertainty, remove it from the candidate architecture.
retest_rule: Any material ecosystem shift may mark the operational conclusion STALE_RETEST_REQUIRED without erasing historical evidence.
architecture_effect: P5 is the first protocol allowed to justify an integrated operational DV architecture.
